## Puoi aspettarti questo. Se vuoi deliziare i clienti, allora sei nel posto giusto. Presso il contact center di Briga nel Vallese hai la possibilità di mettere a frutto le tue competenze e allo stesso tempo acquisire nuove competenze che arricchiranno e faranno avanzare la tua carriera. Entrate a far parte delle FFS e affrontate una vasta gamma di compiti. Delizia i nostri clienti con una consulenza professionale. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti. L'orario di lavoro irregolare, il lavoro notturno e il fine settimana vengono pagati in aggiunta, ad esempio con 16 franchi l'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Rendi più flessibile il tuo tempo libero grazie all'orario di lavoro irregolare. Dopo la formazione retribuita hai anche la possibilità di lavorare parzialmente da casa. Le altre nostre prestazioni come gli assegni per figli, l'AG gratuito in 2a classe e i viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - le trovate sul nostro sito web alla voce Prestazioni. Puoi spostarlo. - Consigli ai clienti telefonicamente e per iscritto, contribuendo in modo importante all'elevata soddisfazione del cliente. - In qualità di consulente clienti, sei in contatto quotidiano con i nostri viaggiatori e vendi con passione offerte nazionali e internazionali. - Durante le discussioni di vendita, ti impegni nella vasta gamma di servizi e li offri ai nostri clienti in modo orientato alla soluzione e su misura. - Supportate e consigliate i nostri clienti anche in caso di domande sulle offerte su ffs.ch o sulla nostra app mobile FFS. Scopri di più sulla descrizione del lavoro qui. Questo è quello che porti con te.

- Ti piace molto il contatto quotidiano con i clienti e la consulenza professionale ai clienti e puoi adattarti bene ai diversi interlocutori al telefono. - Sei un giocatore di squadra e ti assumi la responsabilità personale. - Hai completato una formazione di base nei settori vendita al dettaglio, commerciale, dialogo con i clienti, turismo o aree simili. - Tedesco livello C2. Costituiscono titolo preferenziale il francese al livello B1 e l'inglese e/o italiano al livello A2. - Hai esperienza nell'uso dei comuni programmi MS Office e hai un talento per i media digitali. La tua formazione. Essendo uno dei punti di contatto più importanti delle FFS, sarai ben preparato per questo compito: puoi aspettarti un secondo corso di formazione retribuito ampio e orientato alla pratica a Briga. Le giornate scolastiche si svolgono il martedì, giovedì e venerdì. Dopo aver superato con successo l'esame finale sarete pronti a lavorare come consulente alla clientela presso il Contact Center FFS con sede a Briga.

## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefit.
La classificazione durante il secondo allenamento si basa sulla funzione e sull'età. Puoi scoprire di più sullo stipendio specifico per questo ruolo nella voce laterale.

Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura.
Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda.

Move Switzerland with us.
Lateral entry as customer advisor in the contact center
Brig, November 1st, 2026 or by arrangement, 60-100%
Apply now

## You can look forward to this. If you want to delight customers, then you’ve come to the right place. At the contact center in Brig in Valais you have the chance to use your skills and at the same time acquire new skills that will enrich and advance your career. Become part of SBB and look forward to a wide variety of tasks. Delight our customers with professional advice. Attractive working conditions are important to us. Irregular working hours, night and weekend work are paid additionally - for example with 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. Make your free time more flexible thanks to irregular working hours. After the paid training, you also have the opportunity to work partially from home. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - You advise customers by phone and in writing, making an important contribution to high customer satisfaction. - As a customer advisor, you are in daily contact with our travelers and passionately sell national and international offers. - During sales discussions, you are committed to the diverse range of services and offer them to our customers in a solution-oriented and tailor-made manner. - You also support and advise our customers with questions about offers on sbb.ch or our SBB mobile app. Find out more about the job description here. This is what you bring with you.

- You really enjoy daily customer contact and professionally advising customers and you can adapt well to different conversation partners on the phone. - You are a team player and take personal responsibility. - You have completed basic training in retail, commercial areas, customer dialogue, tourism or a similar area. - German at level C2. French at level B1 and English and/or Italian at level A2 are an advantage. - You are experienced in using common MS Office programs and have a flair for digital media. Your training. As one of the most important touchpoints at SBB, you will be well prepared for this task: you can expect a broad and practice-oriented paid second training course in Brig. The school days take place on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Fridays. After successfully completing the final exam, you will be ready to work as a customer advisor in the SBB Contact Center based in Brig.

## Your salary and your benefits.
Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry.

## This gets you started.
The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool.
Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application.

Entrée latérale en tant que conseiller clientèle dans le centre de contact
Brigue, 1er novembre 2026 ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100%
Postulez maintenant

## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela. Si vous souhaitez ravir vos clients, vous êtes au bon endroit. Au centre de contact de Brigue en Valais, vous avez la possibilité d'utiliser vos compétences et en même temps d'acquérir de nouvelles compétences qui enrichiront et feront progresser votre carrière. Devenez membre des CFF et réjouissez-vous d’accomplir des tâches très diverses. Faites plaisir à nos clients avec des conseils professionnels. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous. Les horaires de travail irréguliers, le travail de nuit et le week-end sont rémunérés en supplément - par exemple 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Rendez votre temps libre plus flexible grâce à des horaires de travail irréguliers. Après la formation rémunérée, vous avez également la possibilité de travailler partiellement à domicile. Vous trouverez nos autres avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille - sur notre site Internet sous Avantages. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - Vous conseillez les clients par téléphone et par écrit, apportant une contribution importante à une grande satisfaction client. - En tant que conseiller clientèle, vous êtes en contact quotidien avec nos voyageurs et vendez avec passion des offres nationales et internationales. - Lors des discussions commerciales, vous vous engagez sur la diversité des prestations et les proposez à nos clients de manière orientée solutions et sur mesure. - Vous accompagnez et conseillez également nos clients en cas de questions sur les offres sur CFF.ch ou sur notre application mobile CFF. Apprenez-en davantage sur la description de poste ici. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous.

- Vous appréciez vraiment le contact quotidien avec les clients et le conseil professionnel des clients et vous savez bien vous adapter aux différents interlocuteurs au téléphone. - Vous avez l'esprit d'équipe et assumez vos responsabilités personnelles. - Vous avez suivi une formation de base dans le commerce de détail, les domaines commerciaux, le dialogue client, le tourisme ou un domaine similaire. - Allemand au niveau C2. Le français au niveau B1 et l'anglais et/ou l'italien au niveau A2 sont un avantage. - Vous êtes expérimenté dans l'utilisation des programmes MS Office courants et avez un flair pour les médias numériques. Votre formation. En tant que l'un des points de contact les plus importants des CFF, vous serez bien préparé pour cette tâche : vous pouvez vous attendre à une deuxième formation rémunérée large et axée sur la pratique à Brigue. Les journées scolaires ont lieu les mardis, jeudis et vendredis. Après avoir réussi l'examen final, vous serez prêt à travailler comme conseiller clientèle au Contact Center des CFF à Brigue.

## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux.
La classification lors de la deuxième formation est basée sur la fonction et l'âge. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur le salaire spécifique pour ce rôle sous entrée latérale.

## Cela vous permet de démarrer.
Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature.
Faire de grandes choses est plus facile si vous le faites vous-même. Cela commence par votre candidature.

Ziegelbrücke, 01.12.2026, 100%

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Als Lokführer:in machst du Grosses: Bei SBB Personenverkehr bewegst du jährlich rund 482 Millionen Reisende. Nach Abschluss der bezahlten 15-monatigen Zweitausbildung führt dich der Job entlang der schönsten Bahnstrecken der Schweiz. Dabei bringst du unsere Fahrgäste pünktlich an ihr Ziel und sorgst so für ein positives Reiseerlebnis mit der SBB.
Voller Perspektiven ist auch dein Arbeitsalltag mit attraktiven Rahmenbedingungen für alle Lebenssituationen. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeit wird bei uns zusätzlich vergütet – zum Beispiel mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen hast du zudem Zeitzuschläge zwischen 10 und 30 Prozent. Das heisst, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze. Ausserdem kannst du nach der Ausbildung zum:zur Lokführer:in dein Pensum nach Rücksprache individuell ab 60 Prozent gestalten, wobei dir unterschiedliche Teilzeitmodelle zur Verfügung stehen.
Mögliche Ausbildungsstarts:
- 1. Dezember 2026
- 1. Juni 2027
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Lokführer:in übernimmst du nicht nur die Spitze des Zugs, sondern auch Verantwortung für Sicherheit und Pünktlichkeit auf dem dicht befahrenen Schienennetz.
- Während deiner Fahrt bist du achtsam und reagierst schnell und richtig auf Signale, Geschwindigkeitsregelungen sowie unvorhersehbare Ereignisse.
- Du handelst selbstständig und stehst jederzeit mit Betriebszentralen und Leitstellen in Kontakt.
- Neben dem Führen und Rangieren der Züge gehört auch das Überprüfen des technischen Zustands vor und nach der Übernahme des Fahrzeugs zu deinen Aufgaben.

Lateral entry train traffic manager: in 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train traffic manager: in Zurich Airport or Limmattal marshalling yard, by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct and monitor the trains at your workplace with around eight screens. During normal operation, you monitor the traffic, control the processes and ensure that things run smoothly. In the event of disruptions, you take over operational management: you analyze the situation, initiate measures and resolve the disruption so that normality is restored as quickly as possible. This means you share responsibility for mobility in Switzerland. Without you the internet comes to a standstill. The job is system-relevant and immediately effective: you coordinate people and technology, make quick decisions and thus make a direct contribution to the safety and reliability of rail transport.
• We offer you paid secondary training to become a train traffic manager, which lasts eight months. After successfully completing your final exam, you will work in the operations center at Zurich Airport or in the Limmattal marshalling yard and help ensure that 9,000 passenger and 2,000 freight trains reach their destination safely and on time every day. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and Sunday work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. Possible start date: - March 1, 2027 - July 1, 2027 - November 1, 2027 You can move this. - As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct trains safely and ecologically and monitor traffic. - During regular operation you observe the traffic; In the event of disruptions, you act calmly and efficiently, take immediate action and restore normal operations. - In the event of disruptions, you take measures to restore normality. - You coordinate and communicate with teammates, locomotive personnel as well as construction and shunting personnel. - You are responsible for customer information at train stations and ensure clear, timely communications. - Thanks to your efforts, passenger and freight trains travel safely and on time around the clock. This is what you bring with you. - You are reliable, enjoy working in a team and are willing to work 24-hour shifts. - You think in a structured and networked way. In stressful situations you act quickly and carefully. Technical affinity is promoted during training. - For the intensive and demanding training period, you bring a lot of personal responsibility and willingness to learn and are motivated to get involved in different learning environments - from face-to-face lessons on site to digital self-study. - You have completed at least three years of vocational training or a high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - In German you are confident at level C2. descriptionByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire du trafic des trains à entrée latérale : à 100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Responsable du trafic ferroviaire à entrée latérale: à l'aéroport de Zurich ou à la gare de triage de Limmattal, sur rendez-vous, 100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. En tant que responsable du trafic ferroviaire, vous surveillez le réseau de lignes qui vous est attribué, dirigez et surveillez les trains sur votre lieu de travail avec environ huit écrans. En fonctionnement normal, vous surveillez le trafic, contrôlez les processus et veillez au bon déroulement des opérations. En cas de perturbations, vous prenez en charge la gestion opérationnelle : vous analysez la situation, engagez des mesures et résolvez la perturbation afin que la normalité revienne le plus rapidement possible. Cela signifie que vous partagez la responsabilité de la mobilité en Suisse. Sans vous, Internet s’arrête. Le travail est pertinent pour le système et immédiatement efficace : vous coordonnez les personnes et la technologie, prenez des décisions rapides et contribuez ainsi directement à la sécurité et à la fiabilité du transport ferroviaire. Nous vous proposons une formation secondaire rémunérée pour devenir gestionnaire du trafic ferroviaire, d'une durée de huit mois. Après avoir réussi votre examen final, vous travaillerez au centre opérationnel de l'aéroport de Zurich ou dans la gare de triage de Limmattal et contribuerez à ce que 9 000 trains de voyageurs et 2 000 trains de marchandises arrivent chaque jour à destination en toute sécurité et à temps. Découvrez-en davantage sur le profil de carrière lors du prochain événement d’information. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage pour profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et le dimanche, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. Vous pouvez trouver des avantages tels que l'AG gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille - sur notre site Web sous Avantages. Date de début possible : - 1er mars 2027 - 1er juillet 2027 - 1er novembre 2027 Vous pouvez déplacer ceci. - En tant que gestionnaire du trafic ferroviaire, vous surveillez le réseau de lignes qui vous est attribué, dirigez les trains de manière sûre et écologique et surveillez le trafic. - En fonctionnement régulier, vous observez la circulation ; En cas de perturbations, vous agissez avec calme et efficacité, prenez des mesures immédiates et rétablissez les opérations normales. - En cas de perturbations, vous prenez des mesures pour rétablir la normalité. - Vous coordonnez et communiquez avec vos coéquipiers, le personnel des locomotives ainsi qu'avec le personnel de construction et de manœuvre. - Vous êtes responsable de l'information des clients dans les gares et assurez des communications claires et rapides. - Grâce à vos efforts, les trains de voyageurs et de marchandises circulent en toute sécurité et à l'heure 24 heures sur 24. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes fiable, aimez travailler en équipe et êtes prêt à travailler 24 heures sur 24. - Vous réfléchissez de manière structurée et en réseau. Dans les situations stressantes, vous agissez rapidement et prudemment. L'affinité technique est favorisée lors de la formation. - Pour la période de formation intensive et exigeante, vous apportez beaucoup de responsabilités personnelles et de volonté d'apprendre et êtes motivé pour vous impliquer dans différents environnements d'apprentissage - des cours en présentiel sur place à l'auto-apprentissage numérique. - Vous avez complété au moins trois années de formation professionnelle ou un diplôme d'études secondaires. Votre motivation est plus importante pour nous que le secteur dont vous êtes issu. - En allemand vous êtes confiant au niveau C2. Vous avez également un sens parfait de la couleur, sans aucune faiblesse rouge-vert. - Lors du processus de candidature, nous vous demanderons de fournir un extrait à jour de votre casier judiciaire et du registre des poursuites (datant de moins de 3 mois). Le document peut être commandé lorsque vous êtes invités à faire connaissance personnellement. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. La classification lors de la deuxième formation est basée sur la fonction et l'âge. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur le salaire spécifique pour ce rôle sous entrée latérale. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. This is what you bring with you. - Reliability is what sets you apart and is reflected in punctuality, quality and safety awareness. - You are physically and mentally resilient for this demanding work and enjoy working outside in any weather. - You have completed basic training with EFZ, ideally in the area of ​​traffic logistics or have already gained experience as a shunter or train driver in the past. - You are in possession of a valid BAV ID card for train drivers in category A40 or Ai40, according to VTE, or are willing to obtain one. - Good knowledge of German (at least level B2) both spoken and written rounds off your profile. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience in Erstfeld, from now on or by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You complete your theoretical training in Olten or Zurich and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and dismantle them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Any questions? We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Special cable fitter, splicer, electrician, electrician, mechanic in German-speaking Switzerland, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. You like working in the great outdoors and enjoy seeing what you've accomplished during the day. You enjoy independent and cross-team work. A reliable and motivated team actively supports you and looks forward to seeing you. We are looking for support at these locations in German-speaking Switzerland: Dulliken. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. But you can enjoy empty swimming pools during the week and organize your free time more flexibly. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. You also benefit from time bonuses. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under “Benefits”. You can move that. - Your main task is to independently carry out maintenance, renewal and troubleshooting work on all cable systems. - You report the work carried out and record working times and expenses. - In this role you will splice copper and fiber optic cables, lay cables and carry out the necessary assembly work. - As head of security, you occasionally monitor compliance with security measures in accordance with the security policy. - For work preparation on the work or construction site, you order materials and coordinate their deliveries. This is what you bring with you. - Your high sense of responsibility and safety will enable you to familiarize yourself well and thoroughly with your new job in the SBB environment. You enjoy working primarily outdoors in all seasons. - Due to our safety regulations, it is important that you are in good health with full hearing and vision. - You have a certificate of skills (EFZ) from the craft sector, preferably from the electrical industry (e.g. electrician, electrician). - Willingness to be trained to become a head of security. - A category B driving license completes your profile. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 2. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Als Lokführer:in machst du Grosses: Bei SBB Personenverkehr bewegst du jährlich rund 482 Millionen Reisende. Nach Abschluss der bezahlten 15-monatigen Zweitausbildung führt dich der Job entlang der schönsten Bahnstrecken der Schweiz. Dabei bringst du unsere Fahrgäste pünktlich an ihr Ziel und sorgst so für ein positives Reiseerlebnis mit der SBB.
Voller Perspektiven ist auch dein Arbeitsalltag mit attraktiven Rahmenbedingungen für alle Lebenssituationen. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeit wird bei uns zusätzlich vergütet – zum Beispiel mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen hast du zudem Zeitzuschläge zwischen 10 und 30 Prozent. Das heisst, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze. Ausserdem kannst du nach der Ausbildung zum:zur Lokführer:in dein Pensum nach Rücksprache individuell ab 60 Prozent gestalten, wobei dir unterschiedliche Teilzeitmodelle zur Verfügung stehen.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Lokführer:in übernimmst du nicht nur die Spitze des Zugs, sondern auch Verantwortung für Sicherheit und Pünktlichkeit auf dem dicht befahrenen Schienennetz.
- Während deiner Fahrt bist du achtsam und reagierst schnell und richtig auf Signale, Geschwindigkeitsregelungen sowie unvorhersehbare Ereignisse.
- Du handelst selbstständig und stehst jederzeit mit Betriebszentralen und Leitstellen in Kontakt.
- Neben dem Führen und Rangieren der Züge gehört auch das Überprüfen des technischen Zustands vor und nach der Übernahme des Fahrzeugs zu deinen Aufgaben.
Erfahre mehr zum Berufsbild an der nächsten Informationsveranstaltung .

- Du hast eine dreijährige Berufslehre oder die Matura abgeschlossen. Deine Motivation ist uns dabei wichtiger als die Branche, aus der du kommst.

- Du bist verhandlungssicher in Deutsch (Niveau C2) und bringst Anfängerkenntnisse in Französisch (Niveau A1) mit.
- Du verfügst über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn (keine Rot-Grün-Schwäche) und weist keine Einträge im Straf- und Betreibungsregister auf.

Macchinista con ingresso laterale: nel trasporto passeggeri 03/2027 Goldau, 1 marzo 2027, 100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Come macchinista fai grandi cose: presso il Trasporto viaggiatori FFS muovi ogni anno circa 482 milioni di passeggeri. Dopo aver completato la formazione secondaria retribuita di 15 mesi, il lavoro vi porterà lungo le tratte ferroviarie più belle della Svizzera. Portate puntualmente i nostri passeggeri a destinazione e assicurate loro un'esperienza di viaggio positiva con le FFS. Anche la vostra vita lavorativa quotidiana è piena di prospettive con condizioni interessanti per tutte le situazioni della vita. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Per i turni notturni è previsto anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Inoltre, dopo la formazione per diventare macchinista, dopo aver consultato voi potete organizzare individualmente il vostro carico di lavoro a partire dal 60% e avete a disposizione diversi modelli di lavoro part-time. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di macchinista non assumi solo la guida del treno, ma anche la responsabilità della sicurezza e della puntualità sulla trafficata rete ferroviaria. - Durante il viaggio sii consapevole e reagisci rapidamente e correttamente ai segnali, ai controlli di velocità e agli eventi imprevedibili. - Agisci in modo indipendente e sei sempre in contatto con i centri operativi e di controllo. - Oltre alla guida e alla manovra dei treni, i tuoi compiti comprendono anche il controllo delle condizioni tecniche prima e dopo la presa in consegna del veicolo. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Aver completato un tirocinio triennale o un diploma di scuola superiore. Per noi la tua motivazione è più importante del settore da cui provieni. - Affronti le sfide con calma, prendi decisioni ben ponderate anche in situazioni di stress e sei disposto a lavorare a turni. - Parli correntemente il tedesco (livello C2) e hai una conoscenza base del francese (livello A1). - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso-verde) e non hai iscrizioni nel registro penale o delle esecuzioni. - Hai molta responsabilità personale e motivazione per il periodo di formazione intenso ed impegnativo e sei disposto a essere coinvolto in diversi ambienti di apprendimento, dalle lezioni in aula in loco allo studio autonomo digitale. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Lateral entry train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 Goldau, March 1st, 2027, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train driver, you do great things: at SBB Passenger Transport you move around 482 million passengers every year. After completing the paid 15-month secondary training, the job will take you along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. You get our passengers to their destination on time and ensure a positive travel experience with SBB. Your everyday working life is also full of prospects with attractive conditions for all life situations. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work – for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you also have a time surcharge of between 10 and 30 percent. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. In addition, after training to become a train driver, you can individually design your workload from 60 percent after consultation, with different part-time models available to you. You can move that. - As a train driver, you not only take on the lead of the train, but also responsibility for safety and punctuality on the busy rail network. - During your journey you are mindful and react quickly and correctly to signals, speed controls and unforeseeable events. - You act independently and are in contact with operations centers and control centers at all times. - In addition to driving and maneuvering trains, your tasks also include checking the technical condition before and after taking over the vehicle. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. This is what you bring with you. - You have completed a three-year apprenticeship or high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You approach challenges calmly, make well-considered decisions even in stressful situations and are willing to work shifts. - You are fluent in German (level C2) and have beginner's knowledge of French (level A1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. - You have a lot of personal responsibility and motivation for the intensive and demanding training period and are willing to get involved in different learning environments - from on-site classroom lessons to digital self-study. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. descriptionByLocale.fr: Entrée latérale comme conducteur de train : dans le transport de voyageurs 03/2027 100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Conducteur de train à entrée latérale : dans le transport de voyageurs 03/2027 Goldau, le 1er mars 2027, 100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela. En tant que conducteur de train, vous faites de grandes choses : chez Transport de voyageurs CFF, vous transportez chaque année environ 482 millions de voyageurs. Après une formation secondaire rémunérée de 15 mois, le poste vous emmènera sur les plus belles routes ferroviaires de Suisse. Vous amenez nos passagers à destination à temps et garantissez une expérience de voyage positive avec les CFF. Votre vie professionnelle quotidienne est également pleine de perspectives avec des conditions attractives pour toutes les situations de la vie. Nous versons un salaire supplémentaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end – par exemple 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les équipes de nuit, vous bénéficiez également d'un supplément de temps compris entre 10 et 30 pour cent. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. De plus, après une formation pour devenir conducteur de train, vous pouvez définir individuellement votre charge de travail à partir de 60 pour cent après consultation, avec différents modèles à temps partiel qui s'offrent à vous. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que conducteur de train, vous assumez non seulement la tête du train, mais également la responsabilité de la sécurité et de la ponctualité sur le réseau ferroviaire très fréquenté. - Pendant votre voyage, vous êtes attentif et réagissez rapidement et correctement aux signaux, aux contrôles de vitesse et aux événements imprévisibles. - Vous agissez de manière indépendante et êtes à tout moment en contact avec les centres d'opérations et les centres de contrôle. - Outre la conduite et les manœuvres des trains, vos tâches consistent également à vérifier l'état technique avant et après la prise en charge du véhicule. Découvrez-en davantage sur le profil de carrière lors du prochain événement d’information. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous avez effectué un apprentissage de trois ans ou un diplôme d'études secondaires. Votre motivation est plus importante pour nous que le secteur dont vous êtes issu. - Vous abordez les défis avec calme, prenez des décisions réfléchies même dans des situations stressantes et êtes prêt à travailler par quarts. - Vous parlez couramment l'allemand (niveau C2) et avez des connaissances de français débutant (niveau A1). - Vous avez un sens parfait de la couleur (pas de faiblesse rouge-vert) et n'êtes pas inscrit au casier judiciaire ou aux poursuites. - Vous avez beaucoup de responsabilités personnelles et de motivation pour la période de formation intensive et exigeante et êtes prêt à vous impliquer dans différents environnements d'apprentissage - des cours en classe sur site à l'auto-apprentissage numérique. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. La classification lors de la deuxième formation est basée sur la fonction et l'âge. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur le salaire spécifique pour ce rôle sous entrée latérale. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature. Faire de grandes choses est plus facile si vous le faites vous-même. Cela commence par votre candidature. ## C'est comme ça que ça continue. × Vous recevrez un premier retour de notre part au plus tard 10 jours ouvrables après réception de votre candidature. Macchinista con ingresso laterale: nel trasporto passeggeri 03/2027 Zugo, 1 marzo 2027, 100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Come macchinista fai grandi cose: presso il Trasporto viaggiatori FFS muovi ogni anno circa 482 milioni di passeggeri. Dopo aver completato la formazione secondaria retribuita di 15 mesi, il lavoro vi porterà lungo le tratte ferroviarie più belle della Svizzera. Portate puntualmente i nostri passeggeri a destinazione e assicurate loro un'esperienza di viaggio positiva con le FFS. Anche la vostra vita lavorativa quotidiana è piena di prospettive con condizioni interessanti per tutte le situazioni della vita. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Per i turni notturni è previsto anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Inoltre, dopo la formazione per diventare macchinista, dopo aver consultato voi potete organizzare individualmente il vostro carico di lavoro a partire dal 60% e avete a disposizione diversi modelli di lavoro part-time. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di macchinista non assumi solo la guida del treno, ma anche la responsabilità della sicurezza e della puntualità sulla trafficata rete ferroviaria. - Durante il viaggio sii consapevole e reagisci rapidamente e correttamente ai segnali, ai controlli di velocità e agli eventi imprevedibili. - Agisci in modo indipendente e sei sempre in contatto con i centri operativi e di controllo. - Oltre alla guida e alla manovra dei treni, i tuoi compiti comprendono anche il controllo delle condizioni tecniche prima e dopo la presa in consegna del veicolo. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Aver completato un tirocinio triennale o un diploma di scuola superiore. Per noi la tua motivazione è più importante del settore da cui provieni. - Affronti le sfide con calma, prendi decisioni ben ponderate anche in situazioni di stress e sei disposto a lavorare a turni. - Parli correntemente il tedesco (livello C2) e hai una conoscenza base del francese (livello A1). - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso-verde) e non hai iscrizioni nel registro penale o delle esecuzioni. - Hai molta responsabilità personale e motivazione per il periodo di formazione intenso ed impegnativo e sei disposto a essere coinvolto in diversi ambienti di apprendimento, dalle lezioni in aula in loco allo studio autonomo digitale. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. La classificazione durante il secondo allenamento si basa sulla funzione e sull'età. Puoi scoprire di più sullo stipendio specifico per questo ruolo nella voce laterale. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry as train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 Zug, March 1st, 2027, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train driver, you do great things: at SBB Passenger Transport you move around 482 million passengers every year. After completing the paid 15-month secondary training, the job will take you along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. You get our passengers to their destination on time and ensure a positive travel experience with SBB. Your everyday working life is also full of prospects with attractive conditions for all life situations. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work – for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you also have a time surcharge of between 10 and 30 percent. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. In addition, after training to become a train driver, you can individually design your workload from 60 percent after consultation, with different part-time models available to you. You can move that. - As a train driver, you not only take on the lead of the train, but also responsibility for safety and punctuality on the busy rail network. - During your journey you are mindful and react quickly and correctly to signals, speed controls and unforeseeable events. - You act independently and are in contact with operations centers and control centers at all times. - In addition to driving and maneuvering trains, your tasks also include checking the technical condition before and after taking over the vehicle. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. This is what you bring with you. - You have completed a three-year apprenticeship or high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You approach challenges calmly, make well-considered decisions even in stressful situations and are willing to work shifts. - You are fluent in German (level C2) and have beginner's knowledge of French (level A1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. - You have a lot of personal responsibility and motivation for the intensive and demanding training period and are willing to get involved in different learning environments - from on-site classroom lessons to digital self-study. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Conducteur de train à entrée latérale: dans le transport de voyageurs 03/2027 Zoug, le 1er mars 2027, 100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela. En tant que conducteur de train, vous faites de grandes choses : chez Transport de voyageurs CFF, vous transportez chaque année environ 482 millions de voyageurs. Après une formation secondaire rémunérée de 15 mois, le poste vous emmènera sur les plus belles routes ferroviaires de Suisse. Vous amenez nos passagers à destination à temps et garantissez une expérience de voyage positive avec les CFF. Votre vie professionnelle quotidienne est également pleine de perspectives avec des conditions attractives pour toutes les situations de la vie. Nous versons un salaire supplémentaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end – par exemple 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience Rapperswil SG, October 1st, 2026, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You will complete your theoretical training in Olten and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and dismantle them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. Cambio di carriera: nel mondo delle professioni meccaniche e artigianali 60-100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Cambio di carriera: nel mondo delle professioni meccaniche e artigianali nella Svizzera tedesca, da subito o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Vuoi un lavoro in cui ogni mossa che fai conta? Alle FFS avete la possibilità di mettere a frutto le vostre competenze e allo stesso tempo di acquisirne di nuove che arricchiranno e faranno progredire la vostra carriera. Hai completato un apprendistato nel settore meccanico e artigianale e vorresti fare la differenza in un ambiente lavorativo stimolante e innovativo? Allora sei nel posto giusto!
• Cerchiamo supporto in queste località della Svizzera tedesca: Zurigo, Brugg, Rapperswil e Winterthur. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Puoi allenarti nel centro fitness durante la settimana, goderti il ​​sole in piscina, fare shopping senza fare la fila: rendi semplicemente più flessibile il tuo tempo libero. Paghiamo un compenso aggiuntivo per il lavoro di guardia, notturno e nei fine settimana. A seconda degli incarichi paghiamo un supplemento tra 300 e 700 CHF al mese. Riceverai anche bonus di tempo del 10-30%. Ciò significa che puoi compensare queste indennità di tempo con tempo libero. Gli altri nostri vantaggi come gli assegni per i figli, l'AG gratuito in 2a classe e i viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce "Vantaggi". Puoi spostarlo. - Siete alla ricerca di un compito entusiasmante, vario e vario con cui potete dare un prezioso contributo ai clienti delle FFS? Le macchine grandi e moderne ti entusiasmano tanto quanto i compiti responsabili e complessi. - Nel tuo nuovo ruolo, a seconda delle tue qualifiche e competenze, sarai responsabile della costruzione, manutenzione e riparazione di sistemi ferroviari come linee aeree, binari, scambi, barriere, segnali o sistemi di protezione dei treni. Questo è un annuncio di pool per tutte le posizioni nell'area sopra menzionata. In base alle tue competenze, esperienza e formazione determineremo l'opportunità di ingresso più adatta a te. Puoi scoprire di più sui nostri interessanti profili lavorativi qui. - In qualità di giocatore di squadra, contribuirai a garantire che le interruzioni vengano rapidamente individuate e risolte. Ti piace dare una mano e ti piace lavorare all'aperto in tutte le stagioni. Come squadra, padroneggerete lavori impegnativi, principalmente meccanici/manuali, sui nostri sistemi. In questo modo fornite un prezioso contributo affinché i nostri clienti raggiungano la loro destinazione in modo sicuro e puntuale. - Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare (a volte nei fine settimana) e/o il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per le tue attività ricreative flessibili. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Un alto senso di responsabilità e sicurezza è un dato di fatto per te. Il lavoro di squadra e la comunità sono importanti per te quanto lo sono per noi. Nel nostro settore, i giochi di squadra sono la chiave del successo condiviso. - Ti piace dare una mano e sei aperto ai nuovi strumenti digitali. Per te la formazione continua è un dato di fatto. Pour notre base de Zurich, nous recherchons des policiers engagés et motivés qui souhaitent se consacrer à un poste passionnant et varié. Pour nous, l'accent n'est pas mis sur le travail de bureau, mais sur une police de proximité à l'écoute de ce qui se passe dans les transports publics, en mettant clairement l'accent sur les tâches de police de sécurité. Ricoprirai un'importante interfaccia all'interno delle FFS nell'ambito d'attività della filiale, il cui fulcro è la sicurezza. Grazie a voi e ai vostri compagni di squadra, ogni giorno le FFS trasportano oltre un milione di persone da A a B. Sosteniamo i vostri desideri di ulteriore sviluppo e vi offriamo molteplici opportunità di formazione interna per la vostra carriera personale alle FFS. Costruttore di strade o muratore) ed esperienza nel settore stradale. - Hai potuto completare la formazione come caposquadra (POS) o come caposquadra SBV e hai completato la formazione come caposquadra SBV (VOS). - Come manager, sei caratterizzato da una buona comunicazione e dalla capacità di lavorare in squadra. - Sei disposto a lavorare con orari irregolari e a lavorare all'aperto. - Possiedi una patente di guida di categoria B., una patente di guida di categoria E valida (rimorchio) è un vantaggio. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. This is what you bring with you. - For this role, you have an apprenticeship in the construction industry (e.g. traffic route builder or bricklayer) and experience in the roadway sector. - You were able to complete further training as a foreman (POS) or as a foreman SBV and completed training as a foreman SBV (VOS). - As a manager, you are characterized by your good communication and your ability to work in a team. - You are willing to work irregular hours and work outdoors. - You have a driving license category B., a valid driving license category E (trailer) is an advantage. ## Your salary and your benefits. Grâce à vous et à vos collaborateurs, les CFF peuvent transporter chaque jour plus d'un million de personnes d'un point A à un point B. descriptionByLocale.it: Caposquadra: nella costruzione dei binari 60-100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Caposquadra: nella costruzione di binari nella Svizzera tedesca, da ora in poi o previo accordo, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Alle FFS avete la possibilità di mettere a frutto le vostre competenze e allo stesso tempo di acquisirne di nuove che arricchiranno e faranno progredire la vostra carriera. Non esageri quando dici che senza di te la Svizzera è ferma! In qualità di caposquadra vi assicurate che il traffico ferroviario si svolga senza intoppi nell'area operativa della filiale. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Ma puoi goderti le piscine vuote durante la settimana e organizzare il tuo tempo libero in modo più flessibile. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Riceverai anche indennità di tempo. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Gli altri nostri vantaggi come gli assegni per i figli, l'AG gratuito in 2a classe e i viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce "Vantaggi". Puoi spostarlo. - In questo ruolo sei responsabile dei lavori di manutenzione, lavori superficiali e di ingegneria civile nell'area stradale. - Il controllo della corretta esecuzione dei lavori e del rispetto delle misure di sicurezza è a vostro carico. - Ti assumerai la direzione di diversi cantieri e la gestione tecnica dei dipendenti. - Il team supporta anche la preparazione e la rendicontazione del lavoro. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei indipendente, un giocatore di squadra e resiliente e ti piace dare una mano. - Hai una buona salute con udito e vista senza limitazioni. - Il presupposto è un tirocinio professionale come costruttore di vie di comunicazione o un tirocinio professionale riconosciuto dalla SEFRI con orientamento artigianale (tre anni) ed EFZ, nonché il potenziale e la volontà di perfezionarsi come caposquadra. Richiediamo che tu sia disposto a lavorare con orari irregolari e ad essere reperibile per questa posizione. Inoltre hai completato con successo la formazione continua come caposquadra nella costruzione di binari e sei responsabile della sicurezza RTE 20100. - Possiedi una patente di guida della categoria B., una patente di guida valida della categoria E (rimorchio) è un vantaggio. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. descriptionByLocale.en: Foreman: in track construction 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Foreman: in track construction in German-speaking Switzerland, from now on or by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. At SBB you have the chance to use your skills and at the same time acquire new skills that will enrich and advance your career. You're not exaggerating when you say that Switzerland stands still without you! As a foreman, you ensure that rail traffic runs smoothly in the branch's operational area. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. But you can enjoy empty swimming pools during the week and organize your free time more flexibly. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. You will also receive time allowances. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under “Benefits”. You can move that. - In this role you are responsible for maintenance work, superficial and civil engineering work in the roadway area. - Monitoring the correct execution of the work and compliance with safety measures is your responsibility. - You take over the management of several construction sites and the technical management of the employees. - The team also supports work preparation and reporting. This is what you bring with you. - You are independent, a team player and resilient and like to lend a hand. - You have good health with unrestricted hearing and vision. - A vocational apprenticeship as a traffic route builder or a vocational apprenticeship recognized by the SERI with a craft orientation (three years) and EFZ is a prerequisite, as well as the potential and willingness to further train as a foreman. We require that you be willing to work irregular hours and be on call for this position. You have also successfully completed further training as a foreman in track construction and are head of safety RTE 20100. - You have a driving license category B., a valid driving license category E (trailer) is an advantage. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level G, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Contremaître : dans la construction de voies ferrées en Suisse alémanique, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60 à 100 % Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Chez CFF, vous avez la possibilité d'utiliser vos compétences tout en acquérant de nouvelles compétences qui enrichiront et feront progresser votre carrière. Vous n'exagérez pas lorsque vous dites que la Suisse reste immobile sans vous ! En tant que contremaître, vous veillez au bon déroulement du trafic ferroviaire dans la zone d'exploitation de la succursale. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Mais vous pouvez profiter de piscines vides en semaine et organiser votre temps libre de manière plus flexible. Nous payons des salaires supplémentaires pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par ex. 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Vous recevrez également des allocations de temps. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes indépendant, joueur d'équipe et résilient et aimez donner un coup de main. - Vous êtes en bonne santé et disposez d'une audition et d'une vision sans restriction. - Un apprentissage professionnel de constructeur de voies de circulation ou un apprentissage professionnel reconnu par le SEFRI avec orientation artisanale (trois ans) et EFZ est une condition préalable, ainsi que le potentiel et la volonté de se perfectionner en tant que contremaître. Auf dich wartet eine abwechslungsreiche, bezahlte 9-monatige Vollzeitausbildung. Die theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst du in Olten oder in Zürich und deine ersten Praxiserfahrungen sammelst du in einem regional zugeteilten Rangierbahnhof.
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, um deine Freizeit zu geniessen, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%, was dir mehr Freizeit ermöglicht.

Ti aspetta un programma di formazione a tempo pieno di 9 mesi vario e retribuito. Completate la vostra formazione teorica a Olten o Zurigo e fate la vostra prima esperienza pratica in uno scalo di smistamento assegnato a livello regionale. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Per i turni notturni ricevi un'indennità dal 10 al 30%, che ti dà più tempo libero. Puoi trovare vantaggi come AG gratuita, viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - sul nostro sito web alla voce Benefit e maggiori informazioni sul lavoro qui. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di macchinista di treni da cantiere, dai un grande contributo al rinnovamento dei percorsi (binari, ghiaia, ecc.). - Effettui ed effettui autonomamente vari e complessi movimenti di manovra di treni fino ad un massimo di 100 km/h, li allestisci e smonti e li prepari per il viaggio. - Per garantire la logistica regionale, redigete, richiedete e ordinate gli ordini di guida in tempo e siete responsabili della fornitura dei cantieri con i materiali necessari. - Hai un'elevata responsabilità per la sicurezza operativa dei treni da cantiere. Il controllo della sicurezza sul lavoro e la redazione di reportistica completano l'attività. - Inoltre, sarai impiegato come macchinista per i treni edili in cantiere e saranno richieste le tue competenze tecniche. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Per questo lavoro impegnativo, sei coscienzioso, affidabile, un giocatore di squadra e disposto a lavorare su turni di 24 ore. - Sei fisicamente e mentalmente resistente e puoi agire consapevolmente e correttamente con il tuo modo di lavorare indipendente. - Possiedi almeno due anni di formazione professionale riconosciuta comprensiva di un certificato di idoneità, preferibilmente nel settore edile e con esperienza nella costruzione di binari oppure hai completato il diploma di scuola superiore. - Prerequisito è la conoscenza della lingua tedesca scritta e parlata (livello C1). - Possiedi la patente di guida di categoria B. - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso-verde) e non hai iscrizioni nel registro penale o delle esecuzioni. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience Olten, May 1st, 2026 or by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You complete your theoretical training in Olten or Zurich and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and disassemble them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to 2 months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to 2 months after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102713 Josip Aracic, team leader Telephone +41 79 586 17 10 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. descriptionByLocale.fr: Conducteur de train à entrée latérale : dans un train de construction avec une expérience manuelle 100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Conducteur de train à entrée latérale : dans un train de construction avec expérience manuelle Olten, le 1er mai 2026 ou sur rendez-vous, 100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. Un programme de formation varié et rémunéré à temps plein de 9 mois vous attend. Vous complétez votre formation théorique à Olten ou à Zurich et acquérez votre première expérience pratique dans une gare de triage régionale. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage pour profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. Vous pouvez trouver des avantages tels qu'une AG gratuite, des voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille - sur notre site Web sous Avantages et vous pouvez trouver plus d'informations sur le poste ici. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que conducteur de trains de chantier, vous contribuez grandement à assurer le renouvellement des voies (voies, graviers, etc.). - Vous effectuez et réalisez en toute autonomie des mouvements de manœuvres divers et complexes de trains jusqu'à un maximum de 100 km/h, les formez, les démontez et les préparez au voyage. - Afin d'assurer la logistique régionale, vous rédigez, demandez et commandez à temps les ordres de conduite et êtes responsable de l'approvisionnement des chantiers en matériel nécessaire. - Vous avez un haut niveau de responsabilité quant à la sécurité opérationnelle des trains de chantier. Le contrôle de la sécurité sur le lieu de travail et la création de rapports complètent les activités. - De plus, vous serez déployé en tant que conducteur de train pour des trains de chantier sur le chantier et vos compétences techniques seront requises. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Pour ce travail exigeant, vous êtes consciencieux, fiable, avez l'esprit d'équipe et êtes prêt à travailler par quarts de 24 heures. - Vous êtes physiquement et mentalement résilient et pouvez agir consciemment et correctement grâce à votre façon de travailler indépendante. - Vous disposez d'au moins deux années de formation professionnelle reconnue comprenant un certificat de compétence, idéalement dans le secteur de la construction et avec une expérience en construction de voies ou avez complété votre diplôme d'études secondaires. - La maîtrise de l'allemand écrit et parlé (niveau C1) est un prérequis. - Vous possédez un permis de conduire de catégorie B. - Vous avez un sens parfait de la couleur (pas de faiblesse rouge-vert) et n'êtes pas inscrit au casier judiciaire ou aux poursuites. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. La classification lors de la deuxième formation est basée sur la fonction et l'âge. Guardiano di sicurezza con ingresso laterale / capo della sicurezza Winterthur, da ora in poi o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. In qualità di guardia di sicurezza, ti assicuri che i lavori nell'area della pista siano svolti in sicurezza e nel rispetto delle misure di sicurezza. La vostra vita lavorativa quotidiana è tanto varia quanto i vostri orari di lavoro e i diversi luoghi in cui viaggiate lungo le più belle tratte ferroviarie della Svizzera. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Per i turni notturni riceverete anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry security guard / head of security 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry security guard / head of security Winterthur, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a safety guard, you ensure that work in the track area is carried out safely and in compliance with safety measures. Your everyday working life is just as varied as your working hours and the different locations you travel along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts, you also receive time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can move that. - You are responsible for protecting staff, materials and equipment from the dangers of railway operations and traction power systems. - As a security guard, you warn colleagues at the railway construction site about approaching trains. - You are responsible for setting up and implementing a security system and communicating directly by telephone or radio with the responsible authorities. - You inform those responsible for the construction site about any unusual incidents that have been identified in their area of ​​activity. - You travel a lot and carry out this activity at different locations in your region. More about the job description here. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are prepared to work independently, reliably, as a team player and openly, in shifts (early morning, day, night and weekend shifts). - You are physically and mentally resilient and have a strong sense of security. - Ideally, you have completed basic training (EBA / EFZ) or already have professional experience in crafts, logistics or a comparable area. You have completed your training as a security guard or head of security or are ready to complete it. - You are skilled at using various digital work tools (iPad and iPhone) and applications and are willing to continually educate yourself and learn. - Your fluent German skills round off your profile. Knowledge of a second national language is desirable. - A valid category B driving license (passenger car with manual transmission) and good eyesight and hearing complete your profile. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Application Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102856 Andreas Müller, team leader Telephone +41 79 894 01 98 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

Agent de sécurité à entrée latérale / chef de la sécurité Winterthur, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. En tant qu'agent de sécurité, vous veillez à ce que les travaux dans la zone de la voie soient effectués en toute sécurité et dans le respect des mesures de sécurité. Votre vie professionnelle quotidienne est aussi variée que vos horaires de travail et les différents lieux que vous parcourez le long des plus beaux itinéraires ferroviaires de Suisse. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Nous payons des salaires supplémentaires pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par ex. 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les équipes de nuit, vous bénéficiez également de majorations de temps comprises entre 10 et 30 %. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end.
